A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the alterations in the levels of nucleotides and protein were found to be concentration and tissue dependent.

the alterations in nucleic acid and protein levels in different organs of Clarias batrachaus exposed to cypermethrin or λ -cyhalotrin were organ specific and the extent and direction of alterations were dependent on the concentration of the compound and the organ under study.

the pyrethroids can be considered as potential genotoxins in fish.
the pyrethroids can cause alterations in nucleic acid and protein metabolism and these changes can be organ-specific.
